title: InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning an instruction-tuned language model on new facts often erodes its general abilities. We find that standard fine-tuning lowers instruction-following, reasoning and coding benchmarks by 35 points on average, and that these losses track a collapse in answer length: fine-tuned models at least halve their responses, and the further a response drifts from the initial model's length, the more often it fails. We propose InstructReplay: the initial model answers a set of general instructions once, and during fine-tuning the model is kept close to the initial model on these answers. Across three model families and two domains, InstructReplay reduces the average decline on five general benchmarks from 28.1 to 2.4 points and keeps answer length close to the initial model's, while learning the new facts as well as standard fine-tuning. It balances learning and retention better than seven adaptation methods in all six settings. Controlled

translated_title: InstructReplay：重放助手轮次以在事实性微调中保持通用行为
translated_abstract: 在新的事实数据上对指令微调后的语言模型进行微调，往往会损害其通用能力。我们发现，标准微调平均会使指令遵循、推理和编程等基准下降35分，并且这些损失与回答长度的崩溃密切相关：微调后的模型回答长度至少缩短一半，且回答偏离初始模型长度越远，失败的概率就越高。我们提出InstructReplay方法：让初始模型对一组通用指令各回答一次，并在微调过程中约束模型在这些回答上保持接近初始模型。在三个模型系列和两个领域中，InstructReplay将五个通用基准的平均下降从28.1分降至2.4分，并使回答长度保持接近初始模型，同时在习得新事实方面的效果与标准微调相当。在全部六种设置中，它比七种适应方法都能更好地平衡学习与保持。
tldr: 提出InstructReplay方法，通过让初始模型预先对通用指令生成回答并在微调时约束模型保持接近这些回答，在事实性微调中学习新知识的同时，将通用能力平均损失从28.1分降至2.4分，并避免了回答长度的崩溃。
en_tdlr: Proposes InstructReplay, which replays assistant turns by having the initial model answer general instructions once and keeping the fine-tuned model close to these answers, reducing average general benchmark decline from 28.1 to 2.4 points while learning new facts as effectively as standard fine-tuning.
